title: Built my first game using Google AI Studio
author: Elder_Realm
selftext:
[https://elder-realm.itch.io/void-bound](https://elder-realm.itch.io/void-bound)

It's a pretty simple reflex game I was able to whip up in a day not even using up my daily free allotment of tokens.  
I was honestly stunned at how quickly and easily I was able to iterate and come up with a working version of the game!

It helps that for this particular game I was going for something 1-bit inspired, so it was able to render everything in HTML <canvas>. I never would have been able to do this myself, that way of drawing is a bit too abstract for me.

I was heavily inspired by an old [Kutar](https://www.kutar.com/) game where you are a samurai and attack enemies that come faster and faster. Same mechanic of only being allowed to attack within the correct window or else you lose. I might need to work on the difficulty some more since I can't get passed my highscore of 37, while for the Kutar game I recall making it up to 75 one time.  


Has anyone else built something with Google AI Studio? Apparently you can link your AI key to other tools (like in VS code) to do project types outside of the available frameworks, but I still need to try that myself.
